title: Backward-Direction Onion-Encryption Security
summary: The security model and CGO proof cover only forward onion encryption; extending both to the backward direction remains open.

formal_statement.body: Extend the onion-encryption security model and CGO security proof from the forward direction to the backward direction.

scope.domain: The problem concerns security models and proofs for onion encryption, including Counter Galois Onion (CGO).
parameters: Direction: distinguishes the analyzed forward case from the unresolved backward case
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the onion-encryption security model and the CGO security proof to the backward direction.

citations.label: Secure Onion Encryption and the Case of Counter Galois Onion

progress.summary: The paper's formal treatment covers the forward direction. It explicitly leaves a similar treatment of the backward direction to future work.
citation_labels: Jean Paul Degabriele et al., Secure Onion Encryption and the Case of Counter Galois Onion
